text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Civilization is nothing more than a 
fleeting mirage. 
Place yourself in the harsh clutches of 
nature, and you quickly learn that truth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Here, there are no warm beds, no walls or 
roofs to keep out wind and rain. 
Without a fierce will to survive, one 
simply withers away into dust.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Trek along beast trails, forage on 
wild herbs, and bathe in muddy water. 
Those who cannot will merely fall by the 
wayside—
choice_data_list: (M-My throat is... so dry...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I've finished boiling the water! 
Would you like a break with some mugwort 
tea?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...All of this was to acquire the 'wild.' 
To bring myself even a little closer to 
Daring Tact's 'perspective.'

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You wish to learn authentic survival 
skills—is that correct, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I want to share the same perspective as 
you, even just a little.

I want to see things through your eyes, 
even just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There is one ideal spot. However— 
It will be quite a long journey. Would 
that be alright?
choice_data_list: By all means, yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. In that case, let us head 
there. 
To the mountains filled with memories for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, where we headed was—Daring Tact's 
hometown. 
The very mountain where she first 
challenged an 'overnight survival' trip.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
*deep breath*... Yes, this brings back 
memories. 
Even the smell of the air hasn't changed 
since back then—
choice_data_list:
(...Still, I never imagined we'd come with 
zero tools.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was right. Aside from drinking water 
for the immediate term, 
we hadn't brought a single convenience of 
civilization. This was literal survival.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Now then. First, we must construct a 
shelter to sleep in. 
We will need to gather branches and leaves 
to use as materials.
choice_data_list:
How are we going to gather them, though? 
We don't have any tools—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It will be alright. 
Let us search for good stones together.
choice_data_list: S-Stones...!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We will craft stone tools and use 
them as blades. 
Ah, I will teach you how to make them, of 
course. Don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, Trainer. 
The trick is to select stones that are 
hard and fine-grained.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Starting with shape and size, every single 
stone has its own personality. 
Discerning that is part of the fun, 
really.
choice_data_list: Th-This is tough...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it is for anyone at first. 
I had a difficult time with it when I 
started, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even when you flake them, they rarely turn 
into the shape you want... 
Or you polish them with all your might, 
only for them to be too brittle to serve 
as tools.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still—it's okay. I believe you will 
gradually 
come to feel it as well, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Feel it...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's difficult to explain in words, 
but... by looking and touching, 
you will gradually be able to sense 
whether a stone can become a blade.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is not a supernatural ability, of 
course... 
I think it is simply that past experience 
seeps into your body over time.
choice_data_list:
(Mmh, looks like we've got a long way to 
go...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The trick to making fire is slow at first, 
then gradually faster... 
Like this, grind, grind, grind! You can do 
it!
choice_data_list: Nggghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, look, smoke! Just as expected, 
you're doing wonderfully!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This mountain stream has provided for me 
so many times in the past. 
—Oh. Look, Trainer. There's a huge cicada 
over there!
choice_data_list: ...D-Don't tell me, that's our dinner?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, no, of course not! 
I just thought it might make good fishing 
bait.
choice_data_list: Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a wonderful thought! 
Insects are well-known for their 
nutritional value, after all... 
You really are getting into tune with 
nature, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
(...Am I... supposed to be happy about 
that?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though it was an uphill battle, I 
gradually picked up survival skills. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh. This is a fine stone. 
It might make a good hammerstone, I think.
choice_data_list:
(...How can she even tell that just by 
looking...?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her unique intuition. I still couldn't 
fathom the special 'perspective' 
Daring Tact held toward nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, shall we move on to the 
grand finale 
of our survival camp?
choice_data_list: Right. Our final trial, so to speak.
Yeah. Our final trial, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the final day. The challenge is 
to safely reach the designated checkpoint 
deep in the mountains. 
It's the very same challenge Daring Tact 
took on in the past.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It will be quite a long trek, but with the 
skills you've honed so far, 
I'm sure everything will be fine. ...Let's 
do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We've made great progress. 
Trainer, 
do you know which way we're facing?
choice_data_list: Um... that way is north!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Correct! Looking at the base of trees and 
stones, the side with thicker moss faces 
north. 
I'm so glad you remembered that trick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though the course involved a full day 
of trekking through the mountains, 
we were making steady, trouble-free 
progress, until—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...The terrain has changed since I was 
last here. 
This used to be a gentle slope... but now 
it's a sheer cliff.
choice_data_list:
There's no way we can push forward through 
this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............ 
For now, let's head back a bit and set up 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To come all this way only to be turned 
back. Perhaps nature simply refuses to 
smile on me—at least, not the way it does 
on her.
choice_data_list:
I guess I just don't have the knack for 
this like you do.

I guess I just don't have the knack for 
this like you do.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...That's not true at all. Even I have 
only just gotten a little used to nature 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In fact, when I first came out here long 
ago... on the very first night, I ended up 
crying. It was pitch black all around, and 
I felt so terribly lonely.
choice_data_list: Huh... Even you?
Huh... Even you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even in familiar woods, spending the 
night is entirely different. 
The slightest rustle or shift in the wind 
terrified me so much that I couldn't fall 
asleep.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
But... then it dawned on me. The mountain, 
nature itself— 
it wasn't making those noises to scare me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Nature is simply there. It isn't an enemy, 
nor is it an ally. 
Being frightened of it was entirely within 
my own head—that's what I realized.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That is why you must view it just as it 
is. And then, blend into it. 
Allow yourself to become a part of nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Only then will nature sustain us. 
Only then will it reveal a path forward—at 
least, that is what I believe.
choice_data_list: (View nature... just as it is.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...So, what would you like to do, Trainer? 
Of course, turning back without pushing 
our luck is a perfectly sensible choice.
choice_data_list: ...No. Give me a second.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I recalled what she had told me yesterday. 
View it just as it is. 
Only then can you discover a way forward. 
If so—
choice_data_list: ...There are plenty of vines around here.
...There are plenty of vines around here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kudzu vines, yes. They are quite tough. 
Though relying on a single strand to 
support our weight would be precarious.
choice_data_list:
...Still, there must be a way to work 
around that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ! ...In that case, what are you thinking?
choice_data_list:
If we braid them together—we can make a 
rope!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Brilliant, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! It caught firmly! 
We can make it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, overcoming our final obstacle, 
we safely reached our destination.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Splendidly done, Trainer. 
You made nature your ally.
choice_data_list:
Maybe I came a little closer to seeing 
things the way you do.

Maybe I came a little closer to seeing 
things the way you do.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yes, I'm certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............Oh? 
Could that be...—!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking closer... I noticed a small pile 
of 
stone tools resting at the base of a tree.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! These... are the tools I left 
behind long ago as proof of my journey. 
Oh my... Hehehe, to think they're still 
here...!
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll add mine too.
In that case, I'll add mine too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beside Daring Tact's relics, 
I stacked the stone tools I had used 
throughout our trek.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe—now there are two little mountains.
choice_data_list: I'd love to come back here again someday.
I'd love to come back here again someday.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes... indeed. I would love that.
